about.title: RAILBUS Inc.
about.subtitle: World's First 100% Solar-Powered Autonomous Mass Transit System
about.whoDesc: RAILBUS Inc. is a mobility start-up incorporated in Delaware, with international operational headquarters in Dubai Silicon Oasis, United Arab Emirates. We design and deliver the world's first 100% solar-powered elevated autonomous rapid transit network.
about.visionText: Bringing modern, rapid, zero-emission mass transit to cities worldwide to empower sustainable urban growth.
about.missionText: Create the most cost-effective, environmentally sound, and fastest-to-build mass transit infrastructure for cities facing congestion and infrastructure deficits.
about.valuesText: 100% Eco-Friendly, Ultra-Low Capital & Operating Cost, Fully Bankable & Profitable Solution.
about.impactIntro: Transportation represents approximately 25% of global carbon emissions today. RAILBUS introduces a zero-emission paradigm shift.
about.impactEnvDesc: 100% solar-driven through continuous photovoltaic track canopies. Zero tailpipe emissions and aggressive lifecycle carbon reduction.
about.impactDevDesc: Lightweight elevated guideways preserving ground green spaces and eliminating urban road bottlenecks.
about.impactJobsDesc: Direct career opportunities in composite engineering, robotic maintenance, smart grid electronics, and transit ops.
about.impactLivesDesc: Predictable, safe, high-frequency transit connecting outer residential areas with economic hubs with zero waiting time.
about.vehiclesSolarDesc: Track-integrated solar arrays continuously supply energy via direct DC current collectors.
about.vehiclesAeroDesc: Designed for urban landscapes with whisper-quiet acoustics, full HVAC climate control, and full RVAR disability compliance.
about.vehiclesEcoDesc: Interior panels, seats, and flooring manufactured from recycled PET plastics and polyester microfibers, slashing energy and CO₂ by 80% versus virgin PET.
about.railpodDesc: The RAILPOD is a compact autonomous pod designed to deliver privacy, efficiency, and speed for families or groups. Traveling point-to-point without intermediate station stops, it substantially shortens trip duration across the network.
about.tracksFluidDesc: Operates safely above surface congestion on dedicated elevated tracks, completely eliminating collision hazards with road vehicles.
about.tracksCompositesDesc: Non-corrosive, weather-resistant modular composite components prefabricated off-site for rapid street assembly with minimal disruption.
about.tracksMaintenanceDesc: Captive guideways with on-board switching wheels allow pods to continue straight or switch routes effortlessly without track moving parts.
about.stationsStandardDesc: Strategically spaced every 2 to 3 km, sized for local neighborhoods or high-density multimodal interchange hubs.
about.stationsBypassDesc: Stations are built on sidings off the main track: vehicles embarking passengers never obstruct express through-traffic.
about.stationsRealEstateDesc: Elevated accessibility hubs that spur retail footfall and generate recurring revenue for cities and transport authorities.
